workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2] MessagePack: Unbounded memory leak in msgpack C extension on strict_map_key validation failure (Affects msgpack < 1.2.3)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade msgpack to patched release >= 1.2.3: pip install --upgrade 'msgpack>=1.2.3' (Advisory: GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2)
